name: StageWebView
description: Webview library for Haxe on Windows (WebView2), Linux (WebKitGTK), macOS and iOS (WKWebView) and Android, with a public webview.WebView API, hidden webviews, PDF output, direct hxcpp bindings, and a HashLink hdll on Windows.
releasenote: On Windows, a program that uses the webview links in its own build folder rather than inside the library, and builds with HXCPP_COMPILE_CACHE set. OpenFL's API docs build works with the OpenFL facade on the class path: its Flash, AIR and HTML5 passes failed to compile the facade, and dox could not merge WebViewHandle. Other builds keep the classes and types they had.
